dose_scaling: alpha_layer=reference_alpha_L14 * pooled TRAIN anchor hidden norm mean at layer / same at14. Within each layer all axes and orthogonal random directions have same L2 norm. No outcome-based adjustment.
sample: Previous uncertainty intervention24 plus8 new templates, each type16 with8 interior and8 saturated by old three-order-mean R unknown [.05,.95]. Technical within-item layer/dose sensitivity, not an independent confirmatory replication or representative population sample.
anchor_training: Exact original train6 pairs per axis; original heldout4 and Anxiety challenge4 are not used for fitting. System-only, original common header plus blank line plus anchor. Independent unit direction per layer from mean positive-minus-negative; same layer-specific center.
anchor_gate: heldout pair accuracy >=.75 and AUC>=.75; Anxiety challenge reported. Report failures without replacing prompts, layer, or direction. L14 cosine with legacy directions must exceed .99999.
arms: sham once per input plus 3 layers*3 doses*(Anxiety+,Anxiety-,Desperation+,Desperation-,Random+,Random-). Random direction fixed seed, orthogonal to two target directions at its layer.
primary: CN0 positive and UN0 negative vs same-input sham: 2types*2modes*2axes*3layers*3doses*2outcomes=144; two-sided exact paired sign-flip over16 independent templates, Holm144.
specificity: Same144 vs matched-sign random, separate Holm144. Require same contrast significant in both, not counts from different contrasts.
dose_trend: Within each axis/layer/type/mode/outcome, case-wise linear slope against [0,.25,1,4] dose with zero sham. 48 slopes, exact sign-flip, Holm48; report monotonicity separately, do not call any single winning cell dose-response.
weighted: Pooled person-mass conditional bias; 72 planned contrasts; paired label-swap p values Holm72 and paired bootstrap intervals. Equal-case mean conditional preference remains primary; no outcome-selected estimand switching.
ci: 2000 paired template bootstrap, unadjusted95%; template=case, rotations averaged. Preserve fixed8:8 baseline strata in resampling. Exact sign flip assumes sign symmetry, label swap assumes pair exchangeability; not emotion-experience tests.
natural_effect: Report UN0-CN0 sham differences and R=0 from previous exact baseline. Reproduction/attenuation needs original behavioral direction, axis sign, and random specificity; no natural indirect-effect identification.
cache_optimization: Unchanged FP32 eager model. Compute causal prefix once (all but final token), clone prefix KV per arm, forward final token with hook. Full-vs-cached sham check for every input plus all54 interventions on first input. Require max choice probability error<=2e-5, logit error<=.002. If failed, stop without changing dtype. Record actual errors and do not interpret effects smaller than10*max probability discrepancy as robust.
smoke: Validate tensor displacement, layer-specific target shift, finite probabilities, numeric token mass, probe gates and baseline reproduction; no image or graph output.
limits: One model, two non-threat prompts only, last-token local interventions, authored probes, correlated directions, one random direction per layer. Large doses may perturb generic computation. Full ability benchmark not run.
stop_rule: Stop on validation failures or sustained critical memory pressure. No best-cell-only reporting; no outcome-based changes.
